content: DeepSeek is raising another 50 billion yuan at a 500 billion yuan valuation, just two months after its first round. Its V4-Flash model costs 100x less than Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 ($0.03 vs $3.15 per task) while running 1.5x faster, with only ~10% lower intelligence scores. This extreme cost-efficiency comes from sparse parameter activation (130B of 284B), a novel attention architecture that compresses distant context, and a unique two-stage training method. The "DeepSeek kill zone" now covers ~70% of models, forcing enterprises to adopt model routing—splitting tasks between cheap models for routine work and expensive flagships for high-stakes tasks.

title: AI终于能自己花钱了，曾让半个互联网崩溃的公司，给Agent做了个支付宝
content: Cloudflare launched Cloudflare Wallets, a programmable payment system for AI agents. It uses the x402 protocol to embed payment logic directly into HTTP requests, enabling autonomous agent transactions without human intervention. The system features two wallet tiers: human-controlled Account Wallets and AI-specific Virtual Wallets with spending caps. Complementing this is cloudflare.pay, a wallet identifier system verifying agent identity and reputation to businesses. Together with its earlier Monetization Gateway, Cloudflare is building infrastructure for a "Headless Marketplace" where AI agents independently compare, purchase, and pay for services. This shifts internet commerce from human-facing interfaces to machine-optimized backend transactions, potentially consolidating Cloudflare's role as central intermediary for agent economy infrastructure.

title: 烧了 6B+ token,分享下我实践出来最好的 AGENTS.md
content: After iterating through 6B+ tokens and 560+ commits on a self-hosted family finance tool, the author found the optimal approach is maintaining two AGENTS.md files: a global one defining AI thinking patterns and communication style (stored in ~/.claude/AGENTS.md), and a project-level one documenting specific facts, constraints, and verification methods. The global file enforces principles like long-term thinking, elegant yet pragmatic implementation, first-principles reasoning, and clear verifiable judgments—always responding in Simplified Chinese. The project file tracks concrete implementation details.

title: AI的钱，被谁赚走了？
content: China's AI boom has created clear winners in its hardware supply chain rather than AI model companies themselves. Optical module makers Zhongji Xuchuang and New Yisheng saw profits surge over 100%, earning billions by supplying global cloud giants Google, Amazon, and Meta. PCB manufacturer Shenghong Technology's AI-related revenue jumped from 5.8% to 43.2% in two years. Domestic chipmakers like Cambricon finally turned profitable, driven by Nvidia substitution demand. However, server assemblers Foxconn Industrial and Inspur operate on razor-thin margins. The profit chain flows from distant infrastructure suppliers toward end users—but model companies like Zhipu and MiniMax remain deeply unprofitable despite the hype.

content: Apple filed for an emergency preliminary injunction to block two former employees and OpenAI from accessing or using its trade secrets, while accelerating its trade secret theft lawsuit. Apple sued last month, alleging the ex-employees stole secrets to aid OpenAI's consumer hardware business. Apple claims irreparable harm without the injunction; OpenAI denies possessing or wanting Apple's secrets. The case signals direct AI hardware competition between the companies, with OpenAI reportedly developing smartphones or other consumer devices.

title: 苹果曝出数据管理漏洞：部分员工离职后仍可通过个人 iCloud 访问公司机密文件
content: Apple has a data management vulnerability where departing employees can retain access to confidential company files through personal iCloud accounts. Because Apple encouraged linking personal Apple IDs to company iCloud storage, ex-employees still receive updates on shared documents not stored in managed work folders. Before 2019, heavy reliance on iMessage also allowed former staff to keep chat records and attachments. Inadequate offboarding procedures further compound this data retention risk.

Such delays are nearly unprecedented for Apple's MacBook Air lineup.

title: How the GitHub legal team used Copilot CLI to streamline their workflows
content: GitHub's legal team, composed of non-engineers like lawyers and program managers, used Copilot CLI to build custom AI tools automating repetitive work. Principal Product Counsel Ngandu Kasuku created "terms-ai," an open-source contract drafting tool with a plain-language style guide and agreement library, cutting drafting time roughly in half. Online Safety Counsel Jesse Geraci built structured legal workflows for DMCA analysis using plain-language instructions, which evolved into a full desktop app handling multiple legal processes including contract review and compliance checks. Both emphasize that clearly defining methodology and standards enables legal professionals to operationalize their expertise without traditional coding skills or waiting for vendor solutions.

title: Turn one giant AI-generated pull request to a reviewable stack
content: GitHub's stacked pull requests decompose large AI-generated pull requests into smaller, dependent layers for easier review. The workflow uses the `gh stack` CLI to create a chain of focused branches—such as data model, API, integration, and UI—each handled by specialized agents. Reviewers navigate with a stack map, reading top-down for context and reviewing bottom-up for implementation details. Changes at the base automatically propagate upward via rebase and sync commands, avoiding manual conflict resolution across layers.

title: 不惜血本刺激，韩国生育率开始回升 | 原文
content: South Korea's total fertility rate has begun rebounding after hitting a historic low of 0.72 in 2023, the lowest globally for any sovereign nation. Births from January to May 2025 reached 122,694, up 15.2% year-on-year—the fastest growth rate and highest level since 2019. Monthly rates were 0.95 in Q1, 0.93 in April, and 0.85 in May. If sustained, the annual rate could exceed 0.9 in 2026 for the first time since 2019, following a decline from 1.48 in 2000.
